tasks.short: Study tissues, cells, pathogens and toxins.

steps.what: Choose the tissue, cell, pathogen or toxin study method and controls
Prepare and examine actual tissues, cells, pathogens or toxins
Enter actual study measurements in the laboratory notebook system {OTHER}
Interpret tissue, cell, pathogen or toxin structure and function
Write and check actual structure and function study findings
Commit the checked actual biological study findings

tasks.design: Test native measurement import into the laboratory notebook system {OTHER}. Reuse actual instrument readings and sample identifiers, while the microbiologist captures observations, checks mapping and units and interprets the tissue, cell or organism evidence personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instrument measurements can be typed again into study records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory imports can reuse actual exported readings.
tasks.still_hard: Specimen quality, preparation artefacts and biological interpretation require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The microbiologist distinguishes meaningful structure from damage or measurement artefacts.
tasks.altitude: Less numerical re-entry; biological interpretation authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory notebook systems may import instrument measurement files; applicability depends on actual sample identifiers and supported formats.

assumptions: Boundary covers actual biological study through its existing findings record, without adding a report to an undocumented observation.

Instruments in s2 supply actual sample identifier, timestamp, measurement, unit and calibration reference where supported. The microbiologist records actual observations and verifies sample mapping in s3. Image annotation, morphology descriptions and unsupported measurements stay manual; no automatic image interpretation or free structured observation is assumed.

Test native import before code. Already imported readings earn no saving. The provisional 50 percent s3 reduction only applies to repeated numerical and identifier entry; source capture and biological observations remain in retained time.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. The final commit is one percent fully retained and uses the existing findings check.
unknowns: What share of the data record is numerical re-entry rather than observation?
Do instruments export stable sample identifiers?
research_questions: Can native imports reproduce actual study records with the same sample and unit checks?

incremental.description: Maintain instrument-field and sample identifier mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final biological study findings and exact laboratory-record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.50 numerical re-entry = 7.5; minus 1 upkeep = 6.5. If only half the numerical fields can be imported, 3.75 minus 1 = 2.75. Observation, interpretation and commit time are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop sterilisation, preservation or contamination-detection products and procedures.

steps.what: Define actual sterilization, preservation or microbial contamination detection requirements
Choose candidate products, procedures, organisms, controls and acceptance criteria
outputs: chosen microbial product or procedure trial design

steps.what: Run actual sterilization, preservation or contamination detection development trials
inputs: chosen microbial product or procedure trial design

steps.what: Transfer and check actual development readings in laboratory software {OTHER}
Evaluate development results and write and check the product or procedure record
inputs: chosen microbial product or procedure trial design
outputs: checked final microbial product or procedure development record

loop.purpose: Draft development record descriptions from verified trials
loop.input: Verified trial record and scientist-chosen interpretation and procedure changes
loop.check: Microbiologist checks organism, treatment conditions, omitted failures, meaning and unsupported efficacy claims against actual trials
loop.stop: Missing actual trial evidence or two failed drafts returns writing to the microbiologist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native trial fields and fixed headings handle structured results; trial explanations vary and require bounded prose

steps.what: Save the checked final microbial development record
inputs: checked final microbial product or procedure development record

tasks.design: Use native trial-data imports in laboratory software {OTHER} and fixed development-record fields before a bounded prose draft. The microbiologist chooses and tests products or procedures, interprets actual efficacy and limitations and checks the exact final record before saving; no product release is implied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trial readings and development narratives can be entered repeatedly across notebooks and development records.
tasks.enabler_now: Laboratory imports and source-linked drafting can reduce repeated transfer and first-draft writing.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting organisms, challenge conditions and valid acceptance criteria is scientific work; an attractive narrative cannot prove efficacy.
tasks.human_edge: The microbiologist detects a misleading efficacy claim and chooses the next valid development trial.
tasks.altitude: Less trial-record transcription; development and efficacy decisions remain with the scientist.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory imports and source-linked drafting can support development records; actual microbial efficacy and product suitability require scientific evaluation.

assumptions: Sterilisation, preservation and contamination detection are alternative development branches. Boundary includes actual design, trial work and existing development record; commercial, quality or regulatory product release is an actual separate owner decision with no saved labour claimed.

The scientist creates actual sample and control identifiers and conditions in s2-s3; trial instruments supply actual reading, unit and timestamp. The scientist checks these in s4 and manually captures unsupported observations. Interpretation is chosen by the microbiologist in s5 before any narrative draft uses it.

Test native imports and fixed development templates before custom code. Existing notebook imports earn no saving. All result judgement and meaning correction stay in the retained s5 time; only its first-draft prose changes.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. The final save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing record check.
unknowns: Which actual trial readings are re-entered?
How much existing record work is prose rather than scientific evaluation?
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting reduce development-record work after counting all efficacy and limitation checks?

already_counted.description: Interpretation and correction of development narrative remain within s5.

incremental.description: Maintain trial-data mappings and development-record drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final microbial product or procedure development record and exact laboratory destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.60 trial entry + 14*0.30 first-draft prose = 10.2; minus 1.5 upkeep = 8.7. If half the trial entries and prose qualify, 5.1 minus 1.5 = 3.6. Trial work, judgement and save time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse acids, alcohols, enzymes and other substances.

steps.what: Prepare actual substances, standards and controls for chemical analyses
outputs: prepared chemical samples and verified calculation factors

steps.what: Conduct chemical analyses of acids, alcohols, enzymes or other actual substances
inputs: prepared chemical samples and verified calculation factors

steps.what: Transfer actual assay readings into laboratory analysis software {OTHER}
Calculate assay quantities using actual verified dilutions, standards and units
inputs: prepared chemical samples and verified calculation factors

steps.what: Interpret chemical analyses, control validity and actual assay limitations
Write and check the actual chemical analysis findings
Commit the checked final chemical analysis findings

tasks.design: Configure native instrument import and validated assay formulas in laboratory software {OTHER}. The microbiologist prepares and performs the analysis, verifies identifiers, dilutions and controls and interprets and checks the final findings before committing them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assay readings can be copied and routine dilution or quantity calculations repeated manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native measurement imports and checked method formulas can replace repeated transcription and arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Sample contamination, invalid controls and assay interference require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The microbiologist recognises when a numerical result is analytically invalid.
tasks.altitude: Less assay arithmetic and re-entry; analysis and result responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory analysis software can import readings and apply validated assay formulas; method validity and result interpretation remain scientific decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is actual chemical analysis through its existing checked findings record. Patient diagnosis, batch release or external reporting is not inferred from an assay result.

The scientist captures actual sample identifier, dilution, standard lot, factor and method revision during s1-s2. Instruments produce actual reading, unit and timestamp; the scientist verifies their mapping in s3. Missing fields and unsupported files stay manual before s4; the scientist verifies the actual method formula in s1.

Test native imports and method calculation configuration before code. Existing automatic instrument calculations earn no saving; only actual current manual transcription and arithmetic qualify. All control and meaning judgement stays human.
Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Final commit retains its one percent share and uses the existing findings check.
unknowns: Are assay calculations already native and automatic?
Which assays still require manual dilution and reading entry?
research_questions: Do configured calculations reproduce actual validated assay examples including dilution and unit edge cases?

incremental.description: Maintain method formulas and instrument-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s6 checked final chemical analysis findings and exact laboratory-record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.60 entry + 10 arithmetic = 19; subtract 1 upkeep = 18. If half the readings and arithmetic are still manual and eligible, 9.5 minus 1 = 8.5. Lab work, validity judgement and commit time stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research microbial production of useful substances.

steps.what: Find and assess research on bacteria and microorganisms for the actual production question
Choose organisms, media, growth conditions and production experiment controls
Conduct actual microorganism cultivation and product-yield experiments
Transfer and check actual culture and yield data in laboratory software {OTHER}
Interpret microbial growth, production yields and research limitations
Write and check the actual microbial production research findings
outputs: checked final microbial production research findings

steps.what: Save the checked final microbial production research findings
inputs: checked final microbial production research findings

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in the scholarly database {OTHER} and native imports of actual cultivation and assay readings into laboratory software {OTHER}. The microbiologist reads the sources, chooses the experiment, cultivates the organisms and interprets actual growth and product yield.
tasks.previous_blocker: Microbial production research can repeat literature searches and culture-to-analysis data entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search filters and instrument import mappings can reduce retrieval and numerical transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Strain behaviour, contamination and the relationship between growth and useful product yield require experiments and interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The microbiologist notices when promising yield reflects an assay artefact or an unstable culture.
tasks.altitude: Less source finding and numerical re-entry; research direction stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scholarly database filters and laboratory imports can reduce repeated retrieval and numerical data entry in microbial production studies.

assumptions: Boundary is actual research on production of substances such as vitamins, antibiotics, amino acids, alcohols, sugars or polymers, through its existing findings record. Industrial production and product release are not implied.

Scholarly database supplies indexed source metadata. The scientist creates actual strain, culture, medium, condition and sample identifiers in s2-s3; instruments supply actual time, reading and unit. The scientist checks mapping and manually records observations in s4; missing exports stay manual. No free structured culture record is assumed.

Test native search and imports before code. Existing automatic capture earns no saving. Only retrieval and repeated numerical fields change; reading, experimental work, interpretation and actual findings writing stay retained.
Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Same-system save has one percent fully retained time and uses the existing findings check.
unknowns: Which culture and assay identifiers are consistent?
How much source finding and numerical entry is repeated manually?
research_questions: Can actual culture and yield files be joined without ambiguity and without hiding manual observation work?

incremental.description: Maintain search filters and culture-to-assay import mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s6 checked final microbial production research findings and exact laboratory destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.30 retrieval + 10*0.60 numerical entry = 10.5; subtract 1 upkeep = 9.5. With half of retrieval and data entry eligible, 5.25 minus 1 = 4.25. Cultivation and scientific decisions are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Scientific and laboratory responsibility stay with the microbiologist while repeated numerical transfer and document work can shrink.
skills_to_grow: Scientific checks of generated development records
role.ambitious_version: Decision rights stay unchanged; validate lower data-entry effort on actual microbiology studies.
